name: script-only-pipeline
description: Process JSON access logs with script-only components sharing one engine in Node.js and the browser

scripts.build:component: jco componentize --script-only --backend quickjs --backend-qjs-disable-async --backend-qjs-stub-wasi --wit wit --world-name pipeline components/dataset/dataset.ts components/geoip/geoip.ts components/risk-score/risk-score.ts components/top-pages/top-pages.ts -o dist/components
scripts.build: pnpm run gen:types && pnpm run check && pnpm run build:component && pnpm run transpile
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run run && pnpm run test
